item.title: On Top of the World on Sněžka
item.description: Visiting the highest peak on the Czech-Polish border. Hike from Pec pod Sněžkou to Špindlerův Mlýn via Sněžka (1603.3 m) and Krakonoš (1422 m).
item.author: contact@mykolamor.com (Mykola Morozov)

item.title: Ukrainian Hike to Fockenstein and Geierstein
item.description: Joining a Ukrainian group to Fockenstein, then taking on Geierstein alone. Hike from Bad Wiessee to Lenggries via Zwergelberg (1113 m), Fockenstein (1564 m), Schlagkopf (1330 m), and Geierstein (1491 m).
item.author: contact@mykolamor.com (Mykola Morozov)

item.title: A Handful of Castles
item.description: Visiting cool castles and ruins between Moosburg and Landshut. Hike from Moosburg an der Isar to Landshut via Berghofen, Kronwinkl, Ast, and Tiefenbach.
item.author: contact@mykolamor.com (Mykola Morozov)

item.title: Burried in Snow at Kampen
item.description: Doing a cliffside climb of the Kampen ridge after heavy snowfall. Hike from Kreuth Klamm to Lenggries via Brandkopf (1569 m), Spitzkamp (1604 m), Auerkamp (1607 m), and Ochsenkamp (1594 m).
item.author: contact@mykolamor.com (Mykola Morozov)

item.title: Retrieving a Hiking Stick at Sonnenberg
item.description: Going back to the place I failed to take back what's mine. Hike from Unterammergau and back via Sonnenberg (1622 m).
item.author: contact@mykolamor.com (Mykola Morozov)

item.title: All Peaks from Bichl to Bad Tölz
item.description: Checking off all easy hikes in the area at once. Hike from Bichl to Bad Tölz via Hollerkopf (932 m), Enzenauer Kopf (1205 m), Fahrtkopf (1203 m), Angerlkopf (1249 m), Stallauer Kopf (1322 m), Stallauer Eck (1213 m), Zwiesel (1348 m), Heigelkopf (1218 m), and Blomberg (1237/1203/1248 m).
item.author: contact@mykolamor.com (Mykola Morozov)

item.title: Relaxing Spring Views at Traunsee
item.description: Letting Pavlo recover on a nice walk. Hike from Traunkirchen Ort to Traunkirchen via Baalstein (800 m) and Geißwand (872 m).
item.author: contact@mykolamor.com (Mykola Morozov)

item.title: First Hike Near Linz
item.description: Taking Pavlo for a tour near Hallstätter See. Hike from Gosau to Bad Goisern via Hoher Kalmberg (1833 m).
item.author: contact@mykolamor.com (Mykola Morozov)

item.title: Falling from Sonnenberg
item.description: A free fall from a cliff keeps a doctor scared and stiff. Hike from Oberammergau to Unterammergau via Zahn (1483 m) and Sonnenberg (1622 m).
item.author: contact@mykolamor.com (Mykola Morozov)

item.title: A Very Social Hike to Bolsterlanger Horn
item.description: Scouting out the ridges around Fischen im Allgäu. Hike from Bolsterlang and back via Bolsterlanger Horn (1586 m).
item.author: contact@mykolamor.com (Mykola Morozov)

item.title: Bridging Countries via Trainsjoch
item.description: Trailing the border line between Germany and Austria on a winter trip. Hike from Kiefersfelden to Bayrischzell via Trainsjoch (1707 m) and Nesselberg (1363 m).
item.author: contact@mykolamor.com (Mykola Morozov)

item.title: Snowy Setzberg
item.description: Plowing through the waist-deep snow to a skiing summit. Hike from Kreuth to Rottach-Egern via Setzberg (1706 m).
item.author: contact@mykolamor.com (Mykola Morozov)

item.title: First Trip to the Dolomites
item.description: Attempting a rocky peak at the cold of winter. Hike from Molveno and back via Palon de Tovre (1913 m) and Cima Sophia (2360 m).
item.author: contact@mykolamor.com (Mykola Morozov)

item.title: Slippery Rainerkopf
item.description: Going down a slippery slope with a friend. Hike from Neuhaus to Spitzingsee via Rainerkopf (1463 m).
item.author: contact@mykolamor.com (Mykola Morozov)

item.title: A Homely Hike to Jochberg
item.description: Joining a group of Ukrainians on a social hike. Hike from Kochelsee to Walchensee via Laimbachfall, Sonnenspitz (1259 m), and Jochberg (1565 m).
item.author: contact@mykolamor.com (Mykola Morozov)

item.title: Kufstein Christmas Market
item.description: Socializing on a nice relaxing hike in Austria. Hike from Kiefersfelden to Kufstein via Thierberg (721 m).
item.author: contact@mykolamor.com (Mykola Morozov)

item.title: Steep Price for a Steep Hike to Vordere Kesselschneid
item.description: Extending the old route to a new peak with a broken finger. Hike from Kufstein and back via Pyramidenspitze (1997 m) and Vordere Kesselschneid (2002 m).
item.author: contact@mykolamor.com (Mykola Morozov)

item.title: Bischof and Krottenkopf Trial
item.description: Catching the last warm days of the year and finishing off my to-do list. Hike from Farchant to Eschenlohe via Bischof (2033 m) and Krottenkopf (2086 m).
item.author: contact@mykolamor.com (Mykola Morozov)

item.title: DAAD Trip to Bodenschneid
item.description: A medium difficulty muddy walk to the peak and down to Bodenschneidhaus. Hike from Spitzingsee to Neuhaus via Bodenschneid (1669 m) and Rinnerspitz (1611 m).
item.author: contact@mykolamor.com (Mykola Morozov)

item.title: Tegernsee to Hausham via Auer Berg
item.description: Beginner-friendly route across Gindelalmschneid (1335 m) and Auer Berg (1252 m). Hike from Tegernsee to Hausham via Gindelalmschneid (1335 m), Auer Berg (1252 m), Rainer Berg (1169 m), and Huberspitz (1051 m).
item.author: contact@mykolamor.com (Mykola Morozov)
